capabilities: Insert dated inline moment headings into any note
Show a chronological timeline view of all dated content
Filter the timeline by day or the open periodic note
Detect date formats from Daily Notes or Periodic Notes
extras: Offers beta builds via BRAT; the README includes a demo vault folder to explore a working example.
intentEvidence: Daily and periodic notes are a great starting point for date-based organization, but they're not always enough.
motivation: The README says daily and periodic notes are not always enough because dated content ends up spread across notes rather than gathered in one place.
problem: Dated content is scattered across project files, daily notes, and standalone notes, so there is no single view of what happened on a given day.

relations.evidence: Detects date format from Daily Notes or Periodic Notes plugin

summary: Timeline plugin that unifies dated headings inside notes, standalone dated notes, and files touched on a day into one chronological view.
